Capable Fund Accountant successful at managing multiple projects with 5+ years of experience and consistently meeting deadlines under pressure. Extensive knowledge of fund accounting, investment banking and financial management. Strong work ethic and sense of ownership needed to excel in regulated environment.

Skills

Knowledge on fund Accounting ● Knowledge about Futures and Options ● Knowledge about Bond Markets and its valuations ● Knowledge about Mutual Funds, Private equity funds and Hedge funds ● Knowledge of corporate action and its impact on stock price ● Knowledge on evaluation of investment decisions through capital budgeting concepts (IRR, Pay back, NPV, MIRR, ARR, PI) ● Feature skills that are valuable in your profession. ● Knowledge about Equity Markets including Fundamental analysis. ● Knowledge on calculation of cost of capital and capital budgeting decisions

Work History

Experience:1

March 2023 – May

Senior Associate - Fund Accounting

2026

State Street, Chennai

March 2021 – Feb

Associate

2023

State Street (Contract), Chennai

Roles and Responsibilities:

Running of blue book and green book financial statements in SAP Bex.

Preparing and posting daily and periodic dividend distributions.



Passing journal entries using SAP GLSU

Research of capital call and capital distributions notices

Reconciliation of cash and stock for several funds with different Sources. • Reconciliation of Corporate action checklists and TA positions.

Technical Skills

•

Investigating the Aged breaks outstanding and following escalation

matrix.

Verifying Corporate Actions (Stock & Cash dividend, Bonus issue,

Stock split, Reverse stock split, name change or ISIN change,

Mergers, Spinoff, Rights issues and Tender offer etc.) to avoid NAV

errors.

Re Processing Dirty trades with clean price.

Review and release of NAV to the clients.

Prepare reconciliations to source documents of accounting data

entered into the system. Research and clear reconciling items

Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual close for individual funds

Verification of daily expenses calculation (Complex fee, Income

management fee, Reimbursement) and Distribution calculation

Communication with client to understand the needs and

requirements.

Prepares and reviews general ledgers, cash and valuation

reconciliations, investors' capital allocations, financial statements

and footnotes

Performs of Mergers of funds as per client requests

Assist with month-end close process which includes clearing of

Residual cost, fractional shares.

Performs of Mergers of funds as per client requests

Assist with month-end close process which includes clearing of

fractional shares

Private Equity:

Researching private equity capital call notices.

Monitoring the fund's investments and capital activities in order to

ensure that they are booked correctly.

Book and review journal entries into accounting application

Accounting for expenses, including management fee, performance

fee, admin fee, Audit fee, interest rates, and taxes with holding.

Cash bookkeeping and its implication within the business unit and its

basic functionality.

Verifying commitment and uncalled capital from notices. • Capturing important data from LPAs.

Preparing capital call checklist for GPs. • Monitoring the fund's cash flow activities and ensuring that payments are made on time.

Posting journal entries in Investran by understanding the various

journal entry types and how to correctly populate the segments in it.

NAV Calculation, Hedge Funds, Mutual Funds, Fund Administration,

Corporate Actions, Microsoft Office utilities (Word, Excel, PowerPoint),

Accounting package - Tally, TCC, SAP R3, SAP Bex, Geneva, SAP BW

workbook, Financial Modeling, SQL, VBA

Education

MBA-2020 BCom-2018

JNTU, Anantapur SV University- Tirupati

Personal Details

Date of Birth: 14/06/1997

Marital Status: Single

Languages Known: English, Telugu

Gender: Male
